title: Convertirse en and Transformarse en
goal: Use convertirse en and transformarse en for a complete change, with en + noun, also when someone or something causes it.

items: I can use *convertirse en* and *transformarse en* with a noun.
I can say who or what caused the change: *La tormenta convirtió la calle en un río*.
I can use the new words for places.
